verses.ar: الٓرٰࣞ كِتٰبٌ اُحۡكِمَتۡ اٰيٰتُهٗ ثُمَّ فُصِّلَتۡ مِنۡ لَّدُنۡ حَكِيۡمٍ خَبِيۡرٍۙ‏
verses.en: L. R. (This is) a Book, with verses basic or fundamental (of established meaning), further explained in detail,- from One Who is Wise and Well-acquainted (with all things)

verses.ar: اَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا اللّٰهَؕ اِنَّنِيۡ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡهُ نَذِيۡرٌ وَّبَشِيۡرٌۙ‏
verses.en: (It teacheth) that ye should worship none but Allah. (Say): "Verily I am (sent) unto you from Him to warn and to bring glad tidings

verses.ar: وَّاَنِ اسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡا رَبَّكُمۡ ثُمَّ تُوۡبُوۡ٘ا اِلَيۡهِ يُمَتِّعۡكُمۡ مَّتَاعًا حَسَنًا اِلٰ٘ي اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّي وَّيُؤۡتِ كُلَّ ذِيۡ فَضۡلٍ فَضۡلَهٗؕ وَاِنۡ تَوَلَّوۡا فَاِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ كَبِيۡرٍ
verses.en: (And to preach thus), 'Seek ye the forgiveness of your Lord, and turn to Him in repentance; that He may grant you enjoyment, good (and true), for a term appointed, and bestow His abounding grace on all who abound in merit! But if ye turn away, then I fear for you the penalty of a great day

verses.ar: اِلَي اللّٰهِ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡۚ وَهُوَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌ
verses.en: To Allah is your return, and He hath power over all things

verses.ar: اَلَا٘ اِنَّهُمۡ يَثۡنُوۡنَ صُدُوۡرَهُمۡ لِيَسۡتَخۡفُوۡا مِنۡهُؕ اَلَا حِيۡنَ يَسۡتَغۡشُوۡنَ ثِيَابَهُمۡۙ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّوۡنَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُوۡنَۚ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيۡمٌۭ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوۡرِ
verses.en: Behold! they fold up their hearts, that they may lie hid from Him! Ah even when they cover themselves with their garments, He knoweth what they conceal, and what they reveal: for He knoweth well the (inmost secrets) of the hearts

verses.ar: وَمَا مِنۡ دَآبَّةٍ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ اِلَّا عَلَي اللّٰهِ رِزۡقُهَا وَ يَعۡلَمُ مُسۡتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسۡتَوۡدَعَهَاؕ كُلٌّ فِيۡ كِتٰبٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
verses.en: There is no moving creature on earth but its sustenance dependeth on Allah: He knoweth the time and place of its definite abode and its temporary deposit: All is in a clear Record

verses.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ فِيۡ سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍ وَّكَانَ عَرۡشُهٗ عَلَي الۡمَآءِ لِيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ اَيُّكُمۡ اَحۡسَنُ عَمَلًاؕ وَلَئِنۡ قُلۡتَ اِنَّكُمۡ مَّبۡعُوۡثُوۡنَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ الۡمَوۡتِ لَيَقُوۡلَنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا اِنۡ هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا سِحۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
verses.en: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days - and His Throne was over the waters - that He might try you, which of you is best in conduct. But if thou wert to say to them, "Ye shall indeed be raised up after death", the Unbelievers would be sure to say, "This is nothing but obvious sorcery

verses.ar: وَلَئِنۡ اَخَّرۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ الۡعَذَابَ اِلٰ٘ي اُمَّةٍ مَّعۡدُوۡدَةٍ لَّيَقُوۡلُنَّ مَا يَحۡبِسُهٗؕ اَلَا يَوۡمَ يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ لَيۡسَ مَصۡرُوۡفًا عَنۡهُمۡ وَحَاقَ بِهِمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: If We delay the penalty for them for a definite term, they are sure to say, "What keeps it back?" Ah! On the day it (actually) reaches them, nothing will turn it away from them, and they will be completely encircled by that which they used to mock at

verses.ar: وَلَئِنۡ اَذَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ مِنَّا رَحۡمَةً ثُمَّ نَزَعۡنٰهَا مِنۡهُۚ اِنَّهٗ لَيَـُٔوۡسٌ كَفُوۡرٌ
verses.en: If We give man a taste of Mercy from Ourselves, and then withdraw it from him, behold! he is in despair and (falls into) blasphemy

verses.ar: وَلَئِنۡ اَذَقۡنٰهُ نَعۡمَآءَ بَعۡدَ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتۡهُ لَيَقُوۡلَنَّ ذَهَبَ السَّيِّاٰتُ عَنِّيۡؕ اِنَّهٗ لَفَرِحٌ فَخُوۡرٌۙ‏
verses.en: But if We give him a taste of (Our) favours after adversity hath touched him, he is sure to say, "All evil has departed from me:" Behold! he falls into exultation and pride

verses.ar: اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ صَبَرُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ مَّغۡفِرَةٌ وَّاَجۡرٌ كَبِيۡرٌ
verses.en: Not so do those who show patience and constancy, and work righteousness; for them is forgiveness (of sins) and a great reward

verses.ar: فَلَعَلَّكَ تَارِكٌۭ بَعۡضَ مَا يُوۡحٰ٘ي اِلَيۡكَ وَضَآئِقٌۭ بِهٖ صَدۡرُكَ اَنۡ يَّقُوۡلُوۡا لَوۡلَا٘ اُنۡزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ كَنۡزٌ اَوۡ جَآءَ مَعَهٗ مَلَكٌؕ اِنَّمَا٘ اَنۡتَ نَذِيۡرٌؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ وَّكِيۡلٌؕ‏
verses.en: Perchance thou mayest (feel the inclination) to give up a part of what is revealed unto thee, and thy heart feeleth straitened lest they say, "Why is not a treasure sent down unto him, or why does not an angel come down with him?" But thou art there only to warn! It is Allah that arrangeth all affairs

verses.ar: اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ افۡتَرٰىهُؕ قُلۡ فَاۡتُوۡا بِعَشۡرِ سُوَرٍ مِّثۡلِهٖ مُفۡتَرَيٰتٍ وَّادۡعُوۡا مَنِ اسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: Or they may say, "He forged it," Say, "Bring ye then ten suras forged, like unto it, and call (to your aid) whomsoever ye can, other than Allah!- If ye speak the truth

verses.ar: فَاِلَّمۡ يَسۡتَجِيۡبُوۡا لَكُمۡ فَاعۡلَمُوۡ٘ا اَنَّمَا٘ اُنۡزِلَ بِعِلۡمِ اللّٰهِ وَاَنۡ لَّا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَۚ فَهَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ مُّسۡلِمُوۡنَ
verses.en: If then they (your false gods) answer not your (call), know ye that this revelation is sent down (replete) with the knowledge of Allah, and that there is no god but He! will ye even then submit (to Islam)

verses.ar: مَنۡ كَانَ يُرِيۡدُ الۡحَيٰوةَ الدُّنۡيَا وَزِيۡنَتَهَا نُوَفِّ اِلَيۡهِمۡ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا وَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا لَا يُبۡخَسُوۡنَ
verses.en: Those who desire the life of the present and its glitter,- to them we shall pay (the price of) their deeds therein,- without diminution

verses.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَيۡسَ لَهُمۡ فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِ اِلَّا النَّارُؗۖ وَحَبِطَ مَا صَنَعُوۡا فِيۡهَا وَبٰطِلٌ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: They are those for whom there is nothing in the Hereafter but the Fire: vain are the designs they frame therein, and of no effect and the deeds that they do

verses.ar: اَفَمَنۡ كَانَ عَلٰي بَيِّنَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهٖ وَيَتۡلُوۡهُ شَاهِدٌ مِّنۡهُ وَمِنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ كِتٰبُ مُوۡسٰ٘ي اِمَامًا وَّرَحۡمَةًؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِهٖؕ وَمَنۡ يَّكۡفُرۡ بِهٖ مِنَ الۡاَحۡزَابِ فَالنَّارُ مَوۡعِدُهٗۚ فَلَا تَكُ فِيۡ مِرۡيَةٍ مِّنۡهُࣗ اِنَّهُ الۡحَقُّ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: Can they be (like) those who accept a Clear (Sign) from their Lord, and whom a witness from Himself doth teach, as did the Book of Moses before it,- a guide and a mercy? They believe therein; but those of the Sects that reject it,- the Fire will be their promised meeting-place. Be not then in doubt thereon: for it is the truth from thy Lord: yet many among men do not believe

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ اَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ افۡتَرٰي عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًاؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ يُعۡرَضُوۡنَ عَلٰي رَبِّهِمۡ وَيَقُوۡلُ الۡاَشۡهَادُ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَذَبُوۡا عَلٰي رَبِّهِمۡۚ اَلَا لَعۡنَةُ اللّٰهِ عَلَي الظّٰلِمِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Who doth more wrong than those who invent a life against Allah? They will be turned back to the presence of their Lord, and the witnesses will say, "These are the ones who lied against their Lord! Behold! the Curse of Allah is on those who do wrong

verses.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ يَصُدُّوۡنَ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ وَيَبۡغُوۡنَهَا عِوَجًاؕ وَهُمۡ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ هُمۡ كٰفِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Those who would hinder (men) from the path of Allah and would seek in it something crooked: these were they who denied the Hereafter

verses.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ لَمۡ يَكُوۡنُوۡا مُعۡجِزِيۡنَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ اَوۡلِيَآءَۘ يُضٰعَفُ لَهُمُ الۡعَذَابُؕ مَا كَانُوۡا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ السَّمۡعَ وَمَا كَانُوۡا يُبۡصِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: They will in no wise frustrate (His design) on earth, nor have they protectors besides Allah! Their penalty will be doubled! They lost the power to hear, and they did not see

verses.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ خَسِرُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَفۡتَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: They are the ones who have lost their own souls: and the (fancies) they invented have left them in the lurch

verses.ar: لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّهُمۡ فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِ هُمُ الۡاَخۡسَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Without a doubt, these are the very ones who will lose most in the Hereafter

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَاَخۡبَتُوۡ٘ا اِلٰي رَبِّهِمۡۙ اُولٰٓئِكَ اَصۡحٰبُ الۡجَنَّةِۚ هُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَ
verses.en: But those who believe and work righteousness, and humble themselves before their Lord,- They will be companions of the gardens, to dwell therein for aye

verses.ar: مَثَلُ الۡفَرِيۡقَيۡنِ كَالۡاَعۡمٰي وَالۡاَصَمِّ وَالۡبَصِيۡرِ وَالسَّمِيۡعِؕ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِيٰنِ مَثَلًاؕ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: These two kinds (of men) may be compared to the blind and deaf, and those who can see and hear well. Are they equal when compared? Will ye not then take heed

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوۡحًا اِلٰي قَوۡمِهٖ٘ؗ اِنِّيۡ لَكُمۡ نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌۙ‏
verses.en: We sent Noah to his people (with a mission): "I have come to you with a Clear Warning

verses.ar: اَنۡ لَّا تَعۡبُدُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا اللّٰهَؕ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ اَلِيۡمٍ
verses.en: That ye serve none but Allah: Verily I do fear for you the penalty of a grievous day

verses.ar: فَقَالَ الۡمَلَاُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ قَوۡمِهٖ مَا نَرٰىكَ اِلَّا بَشَرًا مِّثۡلَنَا وَمَا نَرٰىكَ اتَّبَعَكَ اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ اَرَاذِلُنَا بَادِيَ الرَّاۡيِۚ وَمَا نَرٰي لَكُمۡ عَلَيۡنَا مِنۡ فَضۡلٍۭ بَلۡ نَظُنُّكُمۡ كٰذِبِيۡنَ
verses.en: But the chiefs of the Unbelievers among his people said: "We see (in) thee nothing but a man like ourselves: Nor do we see that any follow thee but the meanest among us, in judgment immature: Nor do we see in you (all) any merit above us: in fact we think ye are liars

verses.ar: قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُ عَلٰي بَيِّنَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّيۡ وَاٰتٰىنِيۡ رَحۡمَةً مِّنۡ عِنۡدِهٖ فَعُمِّيَتۡ عَلَيۡكُمۡؕ اَنُلۡزِمُكُمُوۡهَا وَاَنۡتُمۡ لَهَا كٰرِهُوۡنَ
verses.en: He said: "O my people! See ye if (it be that) I have a Clear Sign from my Lord, and that He hath sent Mercy unto me from His own presence, but that the Mercy hath been obscured from your sight? shall we compel you to accept it when ye are averse to it

verses.ar: وَيٰقَوۡمِ لَا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مَالًاؕ اِنۡ اَجۡرِيَ اِلَّا عَلَي اللّٰهِ وَمَا٘ اَنَا بِطَارِدِ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡاؕ اِنَّهُمۡ مُّلٰقُوۡا رَبِّهِمۡ وَلٰكِنِّيۡ٘ اَرٰىكُمۡ قَوۡمًا تَجۡهَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: And O my people! I ask you for no wealth in return: my reward is from none but Allah: But I will not drive away (in contempt) those who believe: for verily they are to meet their Lord, and ye I see are the ignorant ones

verses.ar: وَيٰقَوۡمِ مَنۡ يَّنۡصُرُنِيۡ مِنَ اللّٰهِ اِنۡ طَرَدۡتُّهُمۡؕ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوۡنَ
verses.en: And O my people! who would help me against Allah if I drove them away? Will ye not then take heed

verses.ar: وَلَا٘ اَقُوۡلُ لَكُمۡ عِنۡدِيۡ خَزَآئِنُ اللّٰهِ وَلَا٘ اَعۡلَمُ الۡغَيۡبَ وَلَا٘ اَقُوۡلُ اِنِّيۡ مَلَكٌ وَّلَا٘ اَقُوۡلُ لِلَّذِيۡنَ تَزۡدَرِيۡ٘ اَعۡيُنُكُمۡ لَنۡ يُّؤۡتِيَهُمُ اللّٰهُ خَيۡرًاؕ اَللّٰهُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا فِيۡ٘ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡۖ اِنِّيۡ٘ اِذًا لَّمِنَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: I tell you not that with me are the treasures of Allah, nor do I know what is hidden, nor claim I to be an angel. Nor yet do I say, of those whom your eyes do despise that Allah will not grant them (all) that is good: Allah knoweth best what is in their souls: I should, if I did, indeed be a wrong-doer

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰنُوۡحُ قَدۡ جَادَلۡتَنَا فَاَكۡثَرۡتَ جِدَالَنَا فَاۡتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا٘ اِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said: "O Noah! thou hast disputed with us, and (much) hast thou prolonged the dispute with us: now bring upon us what thou threatenest us with, if thou speakest the truth

verses.ar: قَالَ اِنَّمَا يَاۡتِيۡكُمۡ بِهِ اللّٰهُ اِنۡ شَآءَ وَمَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ بِمُعۡجِزِيۡنَ
verses.en: He said: "Truly, Allah will bring it on you if He wills,- and then, ye will not be able to frustrate it

verses.ar: وَلَا يَنۡفَعُكُمۡ نُصۡحِيۡ٘ اِنۡ اَرَدۡتُّ اَنۡ اَنۡصَحَ لَكُمۡ اِنۡ كَانَ اللّٰهُ يُرِيۡدُ اَنۡ يُّغۡوِيَكُمۡؕ هُوَ رَبُّكُمۡࣞ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Of no profit will be my counsel to you, much as I desire to give you (good) counsel, if it be that Allah willeth to leave you astray: He is your Lord! and to Him will ye return

verses.ar: اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ افۡتَرٰىهُؕ قُلۡ اِنِ افۡتَرَيۡتُهٗ فَعَلَيَّ اِجۡرَامِيۡ وَاَنَا بَرِيۡٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُجۡرِمُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: Or do they say, "He has forged it"? Say: "If I had forged it, on me were my sin! and I am free of the sins of which ye are guilty

verses.ar: وَاُوۡحِيَ اِلٰي نُوۡحٍ اَنَّهٗ لَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنَ مِنۡ قَوۡمِكَ اِلَّا مَنۡ قَدۡ اٰمَنَ فَلَا تَبۡتَئِسۡ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَفۡعَلُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: It was revealed to Noah: "None of thy people will believe except those who have believed already! So grieve no longer over their (evil) deeds

verses.ar: وَاصۡنَعِ الۡفُلۡكَ بِاَعۡيُنِنَا وَوَحۡيِنَا وَلَا تُخَاطِبۡنِيۡ فِي الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡاۚ اِنَّهُمۡ مُّغۡرَقُوۡنَ
verses.en: But construct an Ark under Our eyes and Our inspiration, and address Me no (further) on behalf of those who are in sin: for they are about to be overwhelmed (in the Flood)

verses.ar: وَيَصۡنَعُ الۡفُلۡكَࣞ وَكُلَّمَا مَرَّ عَلَيۡهِ مَلَاٌ مِّنۡ قَوۡمِهٖ سَخِرُوۡا مِنۡهُؕ قَالَ اِنۡ تَسۡخَرُوۡا مِنَّا فَاِنَّا نَسۡخَرُ مِنۡكُمۡ كَمَا تَسۡخَرُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Forthwith he (starts) constructing the Ark: Every time that the chiefs of his people passed by him, they threw ridicule on him. He said: "If ye ridicule us now, we (in our turn) can look down on you with ridicule likewise

verses.ar: فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ مَنۡ يَّاۡتِيۡهِ عَذَابٌ يُّخۡزِيۡهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيۡهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيۡمٌ
verses.en: But soon will ye know who it is on whom will descend a penalty that will cover them with shame,- on whom will be unloosed a penalty lasting

verses.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا جَآءَ اَمۡرُنَا وَفَارَ التَّنُّوۡرُۙ قُلۡنَا احۡمِلۡ فِيۡهَا مِنۡ كُلٍّ زَوۡجَيۡنِ اثۡنَيۡنِ وَاَهۡلَكَ اِلَّا مَنۡ سَبَقَ عَلَيۡهِ الۡقَوۡلُ وَمَنۡ اٰمَنَؕ وَمَا٘ اٰمَنَ مَعَهٗ٘ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلٌ
verses.en: At length, behold! there came Our command, and the fountains of the earth gushed forth! We said: "Embark therein, of each kind two, male and female, and your family - except those against whom the word has already gone forth,- and the Believers." but only a few believed with him

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ارۡكَبُوۡا فِيۡهَا بِسۡمِ اللّٰهِ مَجۡرٖىهَا وَمُرۡسٰىهَاؕ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ لَغَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ
verses.en: So he said: "Embark ye on the Ark, In the name of Allah, whether it move or be at rest! For my Lord is, be sure, Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful

verses.ar: وَهِيَ تَجۡرِيۡ بِهِمۡ فِيۡ مَوۡجٍ كَالۡجِبَالِࣞ وَنَادٰي نُوۡحُ اِۨبۡنَهٗ وَكَانَ فِيۡ مَعۡزِلٍ يّٰبُنَيَّ ارۡكَبۡ مَّعَنَا وَلَا تَكُنۡ مَّعَ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: So the Ark floated with them on the waves (towering) like mountains, and Noah called out to his son, who had separated himself (from the rest): "O my son! embark with us, and be not with the unbelievers

verses.ar: قَالَ سَاٰوِيۡ٘ اِلٰي جَبَلٍ يَّعۡصِمُنِيۡ مِنَ الۡمَآءِؕ قَالَ لَا عَاصِمَ الۡيَوۡمَ مِنۡ اَمۡرِ اللّٰهِ اِلَّا مَنۡ رَّحِمَۚ وَحَالَ بَيۡنَهُمَا الۡمَوۡجُ فَكَانَ مِنَ الۡمُغۡرَقِيۡنَ
verses.en: The son replied: "I will betake myself to some mountain: it will save me from the water." Noah said: "This day nothing can save, from the command of Allah, any but those on whom He hath mercy! "And the waves came between them, and the son was among those overwhelmed in the Flood

verses.ar: وَقِيۡلَ يٰ٘اَرۡضُ ابۡلَعِيۡ مَآءَكِ وَيٰسَمَآءُ اَقۡلِعِيۡ وَغِيۡضَ الۡمَآءُ وَقُضِيَ الۡاَمۡرُ وَاسۡتَوَتۡ عَلَي الۡجُوۡدِيِّ وَقِيۡلَ بُعۡدًا لِّلۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: Then the word went forth: "O earth! swallow up thy water, and O sky! Withhold (thy rain)!" and the water abated, and the matter was ended. The Ark rested on Mount Judi, and the word went forth: "Away with those who do wrong

verses.ar: وَنَادٰي نُوۡحٌ رَّبَّهٗ فَقَالَ رَبِّ اِنَّ ابۡنِيۡ مِنۡ اَهۡلِيۡ وَاِنَّ وَعۡدَكَ الۡحَقُّ وَاَنۡتَ اَحۡكَمُ الۡحٰكِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: And Noah called upon his Lord, and said: "O my Lord! surely my son is of my family! and Thy promise is true, and Thou art the justest of Judges

verses.ar: قَالَ يٰنُوۡحُ اِنَّهٗ لَيۡسَ مِنۡ اَهۡلِكَۚ اِنَّهٗ عَمَلٌ غَيۡرُ صَالِحٍࣗ فَلَا تَسۡـَٔلۡنِ مَا لَيۡسَ لَكَ بِهٖ عِلۡمٌؕ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَعِظُكَ اَنۡ تَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡجٰهِلِيۡنَ
verses.en: He said: "O Noah! He is not of thy family: For his conduct is unrighteous. So ask not of Me that of which thou hast no knowledge! I give thee counsel, lest thou act like the ignorant

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَعُوۡذُ بِكَ اَنۡ اَسۡـَٔلَكَ مَا لَيۡسَ لِيۡ بِهٖ عِلۡمٌؕ وَاِلَّا تَغۡفِرۡ لِيۡ وَتَرۡحَمۡنِيۡ٘ اَكُنۡ مِّنَ الۡخٰسِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: Noah said: "O my Lord! I do seek refuge with Thee, lest I ask Thee for that of which I have no knowledge. And unless thou forgive me and have Mercy on me, I should indeed be lost

verses.ar: قِيۡلَ يٰنُوۡحُ اهۡبِطۡ بِسَلٰمٍ مِّنَّا وَبَرَكٰتٍ عَلَيۡكَ وَعَلٰ٘ي اُمَمٍ مِّمَّنۡ مَّعَكَؕ وَاُمَمٌ سَنُمَتِّعُهُمۡ ثُمَّ يَمَسُّهُمۡ مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
verses.en: The word came: "O Noah! Come down (from the Ark) with peace from Us, and blessing on thee and on some of the peoples (who will spring) from those with thee: but (there will be other) peoples to whom We shall grant their pleasures (for a time), but in the end will a grievous penalty reach them from Us

verses.ar: تِلۡكَ مِنۡ اَنۭۡ بَآءِ الۡغَيۡبِ نُوۡحِيۡهَا٘ اِلَيۡكَۚ مَا كُنۡتَ تَعۡلَمُهَا٘ اَنۡتَ وَلَا قَوۡمُكَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِ هٰذَاؕۛ فَاصۡبِرۡؕۛ اِنَّ الۡعَاقِبَةَ لِلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: Such are some of the stories of the unseen, which We have revealed unto thee: before this, neither thou nor thy people knew them. So persevere patiently: for the End is for those who are righteous

verses.ar: وَاِلٰي عَادٍ اَخَاهُمۡ هُوۡدًاؕ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اِلٰهٍ غَيۡرُهٗؕ اِنۡ اَنۡتُمۡ اِلَّا مُفۡتَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: To the 'Ad People (We sent) Hud, one of their own brethren. He said: "O my people! worship Allah! ye have no other god but Him. (Your other gods) ye do nothing but invent

verses.ar: يٰقَوۡمِ لَا٘ اَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ اَجۡرًاؕ اِنۡ اَجۡرِيَ اِلَّا عَلَي الَّذِيۡ فَطَرَنِيۡؕ اَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: O my people! I ask of you no reward for this (Message). My reward is from none but Him who created me: Will ye not then understand

verses.ar: وَيٰقَوۡمِ اسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡا رَبَّكُمۡ ثُمَّ تُوۡبُوۡ٘ا اِلَيۡهِ يُرۡسِلِ السَّمَآءَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّدۡرَارًا وَّيَزِدۡكُمۡ قُوَّةً اِلٰي قُوَّتِكُمۡ وَلَا تَتَوَلَّوۡا مُجۡرِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: And O my people! Ask forgiveness of your Lord, and turn to Him (in repentance): He will send you the skies pouring abundant rain, and add strength to your strength: so turn ye not back in sin

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰهُوۡدُ مَا جِئۡتَنَا بِبَيِّنَةٍ وَّمَا نَحۡنُ بِتَارِكِيۡ٘ اٰلِهَتِنَا عَنۡ قَوۡلِكَ وَمَا نَحۡنُ لَكَ بِمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said: "O Hud! No Clear (Sign) that hast thou brought us, and we are not the ones to desert our gods on thy word! Nor shall we believe in thee

verses.ar: اِنۡ نَّقُوۡلُ اِلَّا اعۡتَرٰىكَ بَعۡضُ اٰلِهَتِنَا بِسُوۡٓءٍؕ قَالَ اِنِّيۡ٘ اُشۡهِدُ اللّٰهَ وَاشۡهَدُوۡ٘ا اَنِّيۡ بَرِيۡٓءٌ مِّمَّا تُشۡرِكُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: We say nothing but that (perhaps) some of our gods may have seized thee with imbecility." He said: "I call Allah to witness, and do ye bear witness, that I am free from the sin of ascribing, to Him

verses.ar: مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ فَكِيۡدُوۡنِيۡ جَمِيۡعًا ثُمَّ لَا تُنۡظِرُوۡنِ
verses.en: Other gods as partners! so scheme (your worst) against me, all of you, and give me no respite

verses.ar: اِنِّيۡ تَوَكَّلۡتُ عَلَي اللّٰهِ رَبِّيۡ وَرَبِّكُمۡؕ مَا مِنۡ دَآبَّةٍ اِلَّا هُوَ اٰخِذٌۭ بِنَاصِيَتِهَاؕ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ عَلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍ
verses.en: I put my trust in Allah, My Lord and your Lord! There is not a moving creature, but He hath grasp of its fore-lock. Verily, it is my Lord that is on a straight Path

verses.ar: فَاِنۡ تَوَلَّوۡا فَقَدۡ اَبۡلَغۡتُكُمۡ مَّا٘ اُرۡسِلۡتُ بِهٖ٘ اِلَيۡكُمۡؕ وَيَسۡتَخۡلِفُ رَبِّيۡ قَوۡمًا غَيۡرَكُمۡۚ وَلَا تَضُرُّوۡنَهٗ شَيۡـًٔاؕ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ حَفِيۡظٌ
verses.en: If ye turn away,- I (at least) have conveyed the Message with which I was sent to you. My Lord will make another people to succeed you, and you will not harm Him in the least. For my Lord hath care and watch over all things

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ اَمۡرُنَا نَجَّيۡنَا هُوۡدًا وَّالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا مَعَهٗ بِرَحۡمَةٍ مِّنَّاۚ وَنَجَّيۡنٰهُمۡ مِّنۡ عَذَابٍ غَلِيۡظٍ
verses.en: So when Our decree issued, We saved Hud and those who believed with him, by (special) Grace from Ourselves: We saved them from a severe penalty

verses.ar: وَتِلۡكَ عَادٌ جَحَدُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَعَصَوۡا رُسُلَهٗ وَاتَّبَعُوۡ٘ا اَمۡرَ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيۡدٍ
verses.en: Such were the 'Ad People: they rejected the Signs of their Lord and Cherisher; disobeyed His messengers; And followed the command of every powerful, obstinate transgressor

verses.ar: وَاُتۡبِعُوۡا فِيۡ هٰذِهِ الدُّنۡيَا لَعۡنَةً وَّيَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِؕ اَلَا٘ اِنَّ عَادًا كَفَرُوۡا رَبَّهُمۡؕ اَلَا بُعۡدًا لِّعَادٍ قَوۡمِ هُوۡدٍࣖ‏
verses.en: And they were pursued by a Curse in this life,- and on the Day of Judgment. Ah! Behold! for the 'Ad rejected their Lord and Cherisher! Ah! Behold! removed (from sight) were 'Ad the people of Hud

verses.ar: وَاِلٰي ثَمُوۡدَ اَخَاهُمۡ صٰلِحًاۘ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اِلٰهٍ غَيۡرُهٗؕ هُوَ اَنۡشَاَكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَرۡضِ وَاسۡتَعۡمَرَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا فَاسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡهُ ثُمَّ تُوۡبُوۡ٘ا اِلَيۡهِؕ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ قَرِيۡبٌ مُّجِيۡبٌ
verses.en: To the Thamud People (We sent) Salih, one of their own brethren. He said: "O my people! Worship Allah: ye have no other god but Him. It is He Who hath produced you from the earth and settled you therein: then ask forgiveness of Him, and turn to Him (in repentance): for my Lord is (always) near, ready to answer

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰصٰلِحُ قَدۡ كُنۡتَ فِيۡنَا مَرۡجُوًّا قَبۡلَ هٰذَا٘ اَتَنۡهٰىنَا٘ اَنۡ نَّعۡبُدَ مَا يَعۡبُدُ اٰبَآؤُنَا وَاِنَّنَا لَفِيۡ شَكٍّ مِّمَّا تَدۡعُوۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡهِ مُرِيۡبٍ
verses.en: They said: "O Salih! thou hast been of us! a centre of our hopes hitherto! dost thou (now) forbid us the worship of what our fathers worshipped? But we are really in suspicious (disquieting) doubt as to that to which thou invitest us

verses.ar: قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُ عَلٰي بَيِّنَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّيۡ وَاٰتٰىنِيۡ مِنۡهُ رَحۡمَةً فَمَنۡ يَّنۡصُرُنِيۡ مِنَ اللّٰهِ اِنۡ عَصَيۡتُهٗࣞ فَمَا تَزِيۡدُوۡنَنِيۡ غَيۡرَ تَخۡسِيۡرٍ
verses.en: He said: "O my people! do ye see? if I have a Clear (Sign) from my Lord and He hath sent Mercy unto me from Himself,- who then can help me against Allah if I were to disobey Him? What then would ye add to my (portion) but perdition

verses.ar: وَيٰقَوۡمِ هٰذِهٖ نَاقَةُ اللّٰهِ لَكُمۡ اٰيَةً فَذَرُوۡهَا تَاۡكُلۡ فِيۡ٘ اَرۡضِ اللّٰهِ وَلَا تَمَسُّوۡهَا بِسُوۡٓءٍ فَيَاۡخُذَكُمۡ عَذَابٌ قَرِيۡبٌ
verses.en: And O my people! This she-camel of Allah is a symbol to you: leave her to feed on Allah's (free) earth, and inflict no harm on her, or a swift penalty will seize you

verses.ar: فَعَقَرُوۡهَا فَقَالَ تَمَتَّعُوۡا فِيۡ دَارِكُمۡ ثَلٰثَةَ اَيَّامٍؕ ذٰلِكَ وَعۡدٌ غَيۡرُ مَكۡذُوۡبٍ
verses.en: But they did ham-string her. So he said: "Enjoy yourselves in your homes for three days: (Then will be your ruin): (Behold) there a promise not to be belied

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ اَمۡرُنَا نَجَّيۡنَا صٰلِحًا وَّالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا مَعَهٗ بِرَحۡمَةٍ مِّنَّا وَمِنۡ خِزۡيِ يَوۡمِئِذٍؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الۡقَوِيُّ الۡعَزِيۡزُ
verses.en: When Our Decree issued, We saved Salih and those who believed with him, by (special) Grace from Ourselves - and from the Ignominy of that day. For thy Lord - He is the Strong One, and able to enforce His Will

verses.ar: وَاَخَذَ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوا الصَّيۡحَةُ فَاَصۡبَحُوۡا فِيۡ دِيَارِهِمۡ جٰثِمِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: The (mighty) Blast overtook the wrong-doers, and they lay prostrate in their homes before the morning

verses.ar: كَاَنۡ لَّمۡ يَغۡنَوۡا فِيۡهَاؕ اَلَا٘ اِنَّ ثَمُوۡدَا۠ كَفَرُوۡا رَبَّهُمۡؕ اَلَا بُعۡدًا لِّثَمُوۡدَࣖ‏
verses.en: As if they had never dwelt and flourished there. Ah! Behold! for the Thamud rejected their Lord and Cherisher! Ah! Behold! removed (from sight) were the Thamud

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُنَا٘ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ بِالۡبُشۡرٰي قَالُوۡا سَلٰمًاؕ قَالَ سَلٰمٌ فَمَا لَبِثَ اَنۡ جَآءَ بِعِجۡلٍ حَنِيۡذٍ
verses.en: There came Our messengers to Abraham with glad tidings. They said, "Peace!" He answered, "Peace!" and hastened to entertain them with a roasted calf

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا رَاٰ٘ اَيۡدِيَهُمۡ لَا تَصِلُ اِلَيۡهِ نَكِرَهُمۡ وَاَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيۡفَةًؕ قَالُوۡا لَا تَخَفۡ اِنَّا٘ اُرۡسِلۡنَا٘ اِلٰي قَوۡمِ لُوۡطٍؕ‏
verses.en: But when he saw their hands went not towards the (meal), he felt some mistrust of them, and conceived a fear of them. They said: "Fear not: We have been sent against the people of Lut

verses.ar: وَامۡرَاَتُهٗ قَآئِمَةٌ فَضَحِكَتۡ فَبَشَّرۡنٰهَا بِاِسۡحٰقَۙ وَمِنۡ وَّرَآءِ اِسۡحٰقَ يَعۡقُوۡبَ
verses.en: And his wife was standing (there), and she laughed: But we gave her glad tidings of Isaac, and after him, of Jacob

verses.ar: قَالَتۡ يٰوَيۡلَتٰ٘ي ءَاَلِدُ وَاَنَا عَجُوۡزٌ وَّهٰذَا بَعۡلِيۡ شَيۡخًاؕ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ عَجِيۡبٌ
verses.en: She said: "Alas for me! shall I bear a child, seeing I am an old woman, and my husband here is an old man? That would indeed be a wonderful thing

verses.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اَتَعۡجَبِيۡنَ مِنۡ اَمۡرِ اللّٰهِ رَحۡمَتُ اللّٰهِ وَبَرَكٰتُهٗ عَلَيۡكُمۡ اَهۡلَ الۡبَيۡتِؕ اِنَّهٗ حَمِيۡدٌ مَّجِيۡدٌ
verses.en: They said: "Dost thou wonder at Allah's decree? The grace of Allah and His blessings on you, o ye people of the house! for He is indeed worthy of all praise, full of all glory

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ عَنۡ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ الرَّوۡعُ وَجَآءَتۡهُ الۡبُشۡرٰي يُجَادِلُنَا فِيۡ قَوۡمِ لُوۡطٍؕ‏
verses.en: When fear had passed from (the mind of) Abraham and the glad tidings had reached him, he began to plead with us for Lut's people

verses.ar: اِنَّ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ لَحَلِيۡمٌ اَوَّاهٌ مُّنِيۡبٌ
verses.en: For Abraham was, without doubt, forbearing (of faults), compassionate, and given to look to Allah

verses.ar: يٰ٘اِبۡرٰهِيۡمُ اَعۡرِضۡ عَنۡ هٰذَاۚ اِنَّهٗ قَدۡ جَآءَ اَمۡرُ رَبِّكَۚ وَاِنَّهُمۡ اٰتِيۡهِمۡ عَذَابٌ غَيۡرُ مَرۡدُوۡدٍ
verses.en: O Abraham! Seek not this. The decree of thy Lord hath gone forth: for them there cometh a penalty that cannot be turned back

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡ رُسُلُنَا لُوۡطًا سِيۡٓءَ بِهِمۡ وَضَاقَ بِهِمۡ ذَرۡعًا وَّقَالَ هٰذَا يَوۡمٌ عَصِيۡبٌ
verses.en: When Our messengers came to Lut, he was grieved on their account and felt himself powerless (to protect) them. He said: "This is a distressful day

verses.ar: وَجَآءَهٗ قَوۡمُهٗ يُهۡرَعُوۡنَ اِلَيۡهِؕ وَمِنۡ قَبۡلُ كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ السَّيِّاٰتِؕ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِيۡ هُنَّ اَطۡهَرُ لَكُمۡ فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَلَا تُخۡزُوۡنِ فِيۡ ضَيۡفِيۡؕ اَلَيۡسَ مِنۡكُمۡ رَجُلٌ رَّشِيۡدٌ
verses.en: And his people came rushing towards him, and they had been long in the habit of practising abominations. He said: "O my people! Here are my daughters: they are purer for you (if ye marry)! Now fear Allah, and cover me not with shame about my guests! Is there not among you a single right-minded man

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا لَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتَ مَا لَنَا فِيۡ بَنَاتِكَ مِنۡ حَقٍّۚ وَاِنَّكَ لَتَعۡلَمُ مَا نُرِيۡدُ
verses.en: They said: "Well dost thou know we have no need of thy daughters: indeed thou knowest quite well what we want

verses.ar: قَالَ لَوۡ اَنَّ لِيۡ بِكُمۡ قُوَّةً اَوۡ اٰوِيۡ٘ اِلٰي رُكۡنٍ شَدِيۡدٍ
verses.en: He said: "Would that I had power to suppress you or that I could betake myself to some powerful support

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰلُوۡطُ اِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَنۡ يَّصِلُوۡ٘ا اِلَيۡكَ فَاَسۡرِ بِاَهۡلِكَ بِقِطۡعٍ مِّنَ الَّيۡلِ وَلَا يَلۡتَفِتۡ مِنۡكُمۡ اَحَدٌ اِلَّا امۡرَاَتَكَؕ اِنَّهٗ مُصِيۡبُهَا مَا٘ اَصَابَهُمۡؕ اِنَّ مَوۡعِدَهُمُ الصُّبۡحُؕ اَلَيۡسَ الصُّبۡحُ بِقَرِيۡبٍ
verses.en: (The Messengers) said: "O Lut! We are Messengers from thy Lord! By no means shall they reach thee! now travel with thy family while yet a part of the night remains, and let not any of you look back: but thy wife (will remain behind): To her will happen what happens to the people. Morning is their time appointed: Is not the morning nigh

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ اَمۡرُنَا جَعَلۡنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَاَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهَا حِجَارَةً مِّنۡ سِجِّيۡلٍ ࣢ۙ مَّنۡضُوۡدٍۙ‏
verses.en: When Our Decree issued, We turned (the cities) upside down, and rained down on them brimstones hard as baked clay, spread, layer on layer

verses.ar: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَؕ وَمَا هِيَ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ بِبَعِيۡدٍࣖ‏
verses.en: Marked as from thy Lord: Nor are they ever far from those who do wrong

verses.ar: وَاِلٰي مَدۡيَنَ اَخَاهُمۡ شُعَيۡبًاؕ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اِلٰهٍ غَيۡرُهٗؕ وَلَا تَنۡقُصُوا الۡمِكۡيَالَ وَالۡمِيۡزَانَ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَرٰىكُمۡ بِخَيۡرٍ وَّاِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ مُّحِيۡطٍ
verses.en: To the Madyan People (We sent) Shu'aib, one of their own brethren: he said: "O my people! worship Allah: Ye have no other god but Him. And give not short measure or weight: I see you in prosperity, but I fear for you the penalty of a day that will compass (you) all round

verses.ar: وَيٰقَوۡمِ اَوۡفُوا الۡمِكۡيَالَ وَالۡمِيۡزَانَ بِالۡقِسۡطِ وَلَا تَبۡخَسُوا النَّاسَ اَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِيۡنَ
verses.en: And O my people! give just measure and weight, nor withhold from the people the things that are their due: commit not evil in the land with intent to do mischief

verses.ar: بَقِيَّتُ اللّٰهِ خَيۡرٌ لَّكُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ ࣢ۚ وَمَا٘ اَنَا عَلَيۡكُمۡ بِحَفِيۡظٍ
verses.en: That which is left you by Allah is best for you, if ye (but) believed! but I am not set over you to keep watch

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰشُعَيۡبُ اَصَلٰوتُكَ تَاۡمُرُكَ اَنۡ نَّتۡرُكَ مَا يَعۡبُدُ اٰبَآؤُنَا٘ اَوۡ اَنۡ نَّفۡعَلَ فِيۡ٘ اَمۡوَالِنَا مَا نَشٰٓؤُاؕ اِنَّكَ لَاَنۡتَ الۡحَلِيۡمُ الرَّشِيۡدُ
verses.en: They said: "O Shu'aib! Does thy (religion of) prayer command thee that we leave off the worship which our fathers practised, or that we leave off doing what we like with our property? truly, thou art the one that forbeareth with faults and is right-minded

verses.ar: قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُ عَلٰي بَيِّنَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّيۡ وَرَزَقَنِيۡ مِنۡهُ رِزۡقًا حَسَنًاؕ وَمَا٘ اُرِيۡدُ اَنۡ اُخَالِفَكُمۡ اِلٰي مَا٘ اَنۡهٰىكُمۡ عَنۡهُؕ اِنۡ اُرِيۡدُ اِلَّا الۡاِصۡلَاحَ مَا اسۡتَطَعۡتُؕ وَمَا تَوۡفِيۡقِيۡ٘ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِؕ عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُ وَاِلَيۡهِ اُنِيۡبُ
verses.en: He said: "O my people! see ye whether I have a Clear (Sign) from my Lord, and He hath given me sustenance (pure and) good as from Himself? I wish not, in opposition to you, to do that which I forbid you to do. I only desire (your) betterment to the best of my power; and my success (in my task) can only come from Allah. In Him I trust, and unto Him I look

verses.ar: وَيٰقَوۡمِ لَا يَجۡرِمَنَّكُمۡ شِقَاقِيۡ٘ اَنۡ يُّصِيۡبَكُمۡ مِّثۡلُ مَا٘ اَصَابَ قَوۡمَ نُوۡحٍ اَوۡ قَوۡمَ هُوۡدٍ اَوۡ قَوۡمَ صٰلِحٍؕ وَمَا قَوۡمُ لُوۡطٍ مِّنۡكُمۡ بِبَعِيۡدٍ
verses.en: And O my people! let not my dissent (from you) cause you to sin, lest ye suffer a fate similar to that of the people of Noah or of Hud or of Salih, nor are the people of Lut far off from you

verses.ar: وَاسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡا رَبَّكُمۡ ثُمَّ تُوۡبُوۡ٘ا اِلَيۡهِؕ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ رَحِيۡمٌ وَّدُوۡدٌ
verses.en: But ask forgiveness of your Lord, and turn unto Him (in repentance): For my Lord is indeed full of mercy and loving-kindness

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰشُعَيۡبُ مَا نَفۡقَهُ كَثِيۡرًا مِّمَّا تَقُوۡلُ وَاِنَّا لَنَرٰىكَ فِيۡنَا ضَعِيۡفًاۚ وَلَوۡلَا رَهۡطُكَ لَرَجَمۡنٰكَؗ وَمَا٘ اَنۡتَ عَلَيۡنَا بِعَزِيۡزٍ
verses.en: They said: "O Shu'aib! much of what thou sayest we do not understand! In fact among us we see that thou hast no strength! Were it not for thy family, we should certainly have stoned thee! for thou hast among us no great position

verses.ar: قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اَرَهۡطِيۡ٘ اَعَزُّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّنَ اللّٰهِؕ وَاتَّخَذۡتُمُوۡهُ وَرَآءَكُمۡ ظِهۡرِيًّاؕ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ مُحِيۡطٌ
verses.en: He said: "O my people! is then my family of more consideration with you than Allah? For ye cast Him away behind your backs (with contempt). But verily my Lord encompasseth on all sides all that ye do

verses.ar: وَيٰقَوۡمِ اعۡمَلُوۡا عَلٰي مَكَانَتِكُمۡ اِنِّيۡ عَامِلٌؕ سَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ مَنۡ يَّاۡتِيۡهِ عَذَابٌ يُّخۡزِيۡهِ وَمَنۡ هُوَ كَاذِبٌؕ وَارۡتَقِبُوۡ٘ا اِنِّيۡ مَعَكُمۡ رَقِيۡبٌ
verses.en: And O my people! Do whatever ye can: I will do (my part): Soon will ye know who it is on whom descends the penalty of ignominy; and who is a liar! and watch ye! for I too am watching with you

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ اَمۡرُنَا نَجَّيۡنَا شُعَيۡبًا وَّالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا مَعَهٗ بِرَحۡمَةٍ مِّنَّاۚ وَاَخَذَتِ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوا الصَّيۡحَةُ فَاَصۡبَحُوۡا فِيۡ دِيَارِهِمۡ جٰثِمِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: When Our decree issued, We saved Shu'aib and those who believed with him, by (special) mercy from Ourselves: But the (mighty) blast did seize the wrong-doers, and they lay prostrate in their homes by the morning

verses.ar: كَاَنۡ لَّمۡ يَغۡنَوۡا فِيۡهَاؕ اَلَا بُعۡدًا لِّمَدۡيَنَ كَمَا بَعِدَتۡ ثَمُوۡدُࣖ‏
verses.en: As if they had never dwelt and flourished there! Ah! Behold! How the Madyan were removed (from sight) as were removed the Thamud

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوۡسٰي بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍۙ‏
verses.en: And we sent Moses, with Our Clear (Signs) and an authority manifest

verses.ar: اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَا۠ئِهٖ فَاتَّبَعُوۡ٘ا اَمۡرَ فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ وَمَا٘ اَمۡرُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِرَشِيۡدٍ
verses.en: Unto Pharaoh and his chiefs: but they followed the command of Pharaoh and the command of Pharaoh was no right (guide)

verses.ar: يَقۡدُمُ قَوۡمَهٗ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ فَاَوۡرَدَهُمُ النَّارَؕ وَبِئۡسَ الۡوِرۡدُ الۡمَوۡرُوۡدُ
verses.en: He will go before his people on the Day of Judgment, and lead them into the Fire (as cattle are led to water): But woeful indeed will be the place to which they are led

verses.ar: وَاُتۡبِعُوۡا فِيۡ هٰذِهٖ لَعۡنَةً وَّيَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِؕ بِئۡسَ الرِّفۡدُ الۡمَرۡفُوۡدُ
verses.en: And they are followed by a curse in this (life) and on the Day of Judgment: and woeful is the gift which shall be given (unto them)

verses.ar: ذٰلِكَ مِنۡ اَنۭۡ بَآءِ الۡقُرٰي نَقُصُّهٗ عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡهَا قَآئِمٌ وَّحَصِيۡدٌ
verses.en: These are some of the stories of communities which We relate unto thee: of them some are standing, and some have been mown down (by the sickle of time)

verses.ar: وَمَا ظَلَمۡنٰهُمۡ وَلٰكِنۡ ظَلَمُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ فَمَا٘ اَغۡنَتۡ عَنۡهُمۡ اٰلِهَتُهُمُ الَّتِيۡ يَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍ لَّمَّا جَآءَ اَمۡرُ رَبِّكَؕ وَمَا زَادُوۡهُمۡ غَيۡرَ تَتۡبِيۡبٍ
verses.en: It was not We that wronged them: They wronged their own souls: the deities, other than Allah, whom they invoked, profited them no whit when there issued the decree of thy Lord: Nor did they add aught (to their lot) but perdition

verses.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَخۡذُ رَبِّكَ اِذَا٘ اَخَذَ الۡقُرٰي وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٌؕ اِنَّ اَخۡذَهٗ٘ اَلِيۡمٌ شَدِيۡدٌ
verses.en: Such is the chastisement of thy Lord when He chastises communities in the midst of their wrong: grievous, indeed, and severe is His chastisement

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّمَنۡ خَافَ عَذَابَ الۡاٰخِرَةِؕ ذٰلِكَ يَوۡمٌ مَّجۡمُوۡعٌۙ لَّهُ النَّاسُ وَذٰلِكَ يَوۡمٌ مَّشۡهُوۡدٌ
verses.en: In that is a Sign for those who fear the penalty of the Hereafter: that is a Day for which mankind will be gathered together: that will be a Day of Testimony

verses.ar: وَمَا نُؤَخِّرُهٗ٘ اِلَّا لِاَجَلٍ مَّعۡدُوۡدٍؕ‏
verses.en: Nor shall We delay it but for a term appointed

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ يَاۡتِ لَا تَكَلَّمُ نَفۡسٌ اِلَّا بِاِذۡنِهٖۚ فَمِنۡهُمۡ شَقِيٌّ وَّسَعِيۡدٌ
verses.en: The day it arrives, no soul shall speak except by His leave: of those (gathered) some will be wretched and some will be blessed

verses.ar: فَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ شَقُوۡا فَفِي النَّارِ لَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا زَفِيۡرٌ وَّشَهِيۡقٌۙ‏
verses.en: Those who are wretched shall be in the Fire: There will be for them therein (nothing but) the heaving of sighs and sobs

verses.ar: خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمٰوٰتُ وَالۡاَرۡضُ اِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيۡدُ
verses.en: They will dwell therein for all the time that the heavens and the earth endure, except as thy Lord willeth: for thy Lord is the (sure) accomplisher of what He planneth

verses.ar: وَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ سُعِدُوۡا فَفِي الۡجَنَّةِ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا مَا دَامَتِ السَّمٰوٰتُ وَالۡاَرۡضُ اِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَؕ عَطَآءً غَيۡرَ مَجۡذُوۡذٍ
verses.en: And those who are blessed shall be in the Garden: They will dwell therein for all the time that the heavens and the earth endure, except as thy Lord willeth: a gift without break

verses.ar: فَلَا تَكُ فِيۡ مِرۡيَةٍ مِّمَّا يَعۡبُدُ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِؕ مَا يَعۡبُدُوۡنَ اِلَّا كَمَا يَعۡبُدُ اٰبَآؤُهُمۡ مِّنۡ قَبۡلُؕ وَاِنَّا لَمُوَفُّوۡهُمۡ نَصِيۡبَهُمۡ غَيۡرَ مَنۡقُوۡصٍࣖ‏
verses.en: Be not then in doubt as to what these men worship. They worship nothing but what their fathers worshipped before (them): but verily We shall pay them back (in full) their portion without (the least) abatement

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسَي الۡكِتٰبَ فَاخۡتُلِفَ فِيۡهِؕ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتۡ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡؕ وَاِنَّهُمۡ لَفِيۡ شَكٍّ مِّنۡهُ مُرِيۡبٍ
verses.en: We certainly gave the Book to Moses, but differences arose therein: had it not been that a word had gone forth before from thy Lord, the matter would have been decided between them, but they are in suspicious doubt concerning it

verses.ar: وَاِنَّ كُلًّا لَّمَّا لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمۡ رَبُّكَ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡؕ اِنَّهٗ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ خَبِيۡرٌ
verses.en: And, of a surety, to all will your Lord pay back (in full the recompense) of their deeds: for He knoweth well all that they do

verses.ar: فَاسۡتَقِمۡ كَمَا٘ اُمِرۡتَ وَمَنۡ تَابَ مَعَكَ وَلَا تَطۡغَوۡاؕ اِنَّهٗ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ بَصِيۡرٌ
verses.en: Therefore stand firm (in the straight Path) as thou art commanded,- thou and those who with thee turn (unto Allah); and transgress not (from the Path): for He seeth well all that ye do

verses.ar: وَلَا تَرۡكَنُوۡ٘ا اِلَي الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا فَتَمَسَّكُمُ النَّارُۙ وَمَا لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ اَوۡلِيَآءَ ثُمَّ لَا تُنۡصَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: And incline not to those who do wrong, or the Fire will seize you; and ye have no protectors other than Allah, nor shall ye be helped

verses.ar: وَاَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَ طَرَفَيِ النَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِّنَ الَّيۡلِؕ اِنَّ الۡحَسَنٰتِ يُذۡهِبۡنَ السَّيِّاٰتِؕ ذٰلِكَ ذِكۡرٰي لِلذّٰكِرِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: And establish regular prayers at the two ends of the day and at the approaches of the night: For those things, that are good remove those that are evil: Be that the word of remembrance to those who remember (their Lord)

verses.ar: وَاصۡبِرۡ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُضِيۡعُ اَجۡرَ الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: And be steadfast in patience; for verily Allah will not suffer the reward of the righteous to perish

verses.ar: فَلَوۡلَا كَانَ مِنَ الۡقُرُوۡنِ مِنۡ قَبۡلِكُمۡ اُولُوۡا بَقِيَّةٍ يَّنۡهَوۡنَ عَنِ الۡفَسَادِ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلًا مِّمَّنۡ اَنۡجَيۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡۚ وَاتَّبَعَ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا مَا٘ اُتۡرِفُوۡا فِيۡهِ وَكَانُوۡا مُجۡرِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: Why were there not, among the generations before you, persons possessed of balanced good sense, prohibiting (men) from mischief in the earth - except a few among them whom We saved (from harm)? But the wrong-doers pursued the enjoyment of the good things of life which were given them, and persisted in sin

verses.ar: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِيُهۡلِكَ الۡقُرٰي بِظُلۡمٍ وَّاَهۡلُهَا مُصۡلِحُوۡنَ
verses.en: Nor would thy Lord be the One to destroy communities for a single wrong-doing, if its members were likely to mend

verses.ar: وَلَوۡ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَعَلَ النَّاسَ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً وَّلَا يَزَالُوۡنَ مُخۡتَلِفِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: If thy Lord had so willed, He could have made mankind one people: but they will not cease to dispute

verses.ar: اِلَّا مَنۡ رَّحِمَ رَبُّكَؕ وَلِذٰلِكَ خَلَقَهُمۡؕ وَتَمَّتۡ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ لَاَمۡلَـَٔنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الۡجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَ
verses.en: Except those on whom thy Lord hath bestowed His Mercy: and for this did He create them: and the Word of thy Lord shall be fulfilled: "I will fill Hell with jinns and men all together

verses.ar: وَكُلًّا نَّقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡ اَنۭۡ بَآءِ الرُّسُلِ مَا نُثَبِّتُ بِهٖ فُؤَادَكَۚ وَجَآءَكَ فِيۡ هٰذِهِ الۡحَقُّ وَمَوۡعِظَةٌ وَّذِكۡرٰي لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: All that we relate to thee of the stories of the messengers,- with it We make firm thy heart: in them there cometh to thee the Truth, as well as an exhortation and a message of remembrance to those who believe

verses.ar: وَقُلۡ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ اعۡمَلُوۡا عَلٰي مَكَانَتِكُمۡؕ اِنَّا عٰمِلُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Say to those who do not believe: "Do what ever ye can: We shall do our part

verses.ar: وَانۡتَظِرُوۡاۚ اِنَّا مُنۡتَظِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: And wait ye! We too shall wait

verses.ar: وَلِلّٰهِ غَيۡبُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَاِلَيۡهِ يُرۡجَعُ الۡاَمۡرُ كُلُّهٗ فَاعۡبُدۡهُ وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَيۡهِؕ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: To Allah do belong the unseen (secrets) of the heavens and the earth, and to Him goeth back every affair (for decision): then worship Him, and put thy trust in Him: and thy Lord is not unmindful of aught that ye do
